//: Deno config for the Edge Functions only. It is scoped to supabase/functions/ and has
no effect on the Vite app build.
sloppy-imports lets Deno resolve extensionless relative imports (`./rng`), which Vite
resolves natively and stock Deno rejects. It is kept for local `deno run`/`deno check`
It is NOT what makes the deploy work, though this file used to say so. Deploying does
not run Deno first — the Supabase API bundler walks the import graph itself, and it
neither resolves extensionless specifiers nor uploads files from outside the function
directory. That is why the resolver imports `./_game/engine/fight.ts`, a generated
extension-qualified copy emitted by tools/bundleDuelResolver.mjs on every deploy.
See ../SETUP.md §5. The copy is 28 modules, 18 of which execute — not the six this
file once claimed, since data/classes pulls in all twelve talent trees.
